title: Our First Engineering Competition Win
subtitle: Guelph Engineering Competition · Innovative Design
paragraphs: A few friends and I entered the Guelph Engineering Competition with H₂@Home, a concept for making hydrogen refuelling more accessible through a residential system.
We worked on the hardware, control system, and how to explain the idea to the judges. Bringing those parts together was as much a communication exercise as a technical one.
We took first place in Innovative Design and qualified for the Ontario Engineering Competition. I enjoyed turning an ambitious idea into something we could demonstrate as a team.
